detail: Ashok Kumar Jain has submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation mandates disclosure when a person or acquirer crosses specified shareholding thresholds (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, etc.). The filing is public and archived on NSE's corporate disclosure portal. The specific acquisition quantum, timing and consideration are not disclosed in the headline filing but would be detailed in the full Form A or CA disclosure document.
